MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The DisplayPort-to-DVI adapter connects to my earlier DVI cable purchase and could solve a related connection problem, provided my equipment actually needs that conversion.",
    "Screen-cleaning cloths have a practical use with the devices I use, although usefulness alone would not make me buy them without a replacement need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The storage drives and optical drive assume I am upgrading a computer, while my purchases show specific connection needs rather than an ongoing upgrade project.",
    "A phone, tablet, or streaming device requires a separate reason to buy; owning accessories does not mean I want to replace or add the devices themselves.",
    "The HDMI cable and dual-monitor mount address setups I have not indicated I need, despite their connection to computer screens."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few useful electronics accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in electronics generally.",
    "An old DVI cable purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest several display-related products, even when they serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are spread over years and appear tied to occasional practical needs, so an earlier purchase is a weak reason to assume I need something related now.",
    "My latest purchase solved a wired-network connection need; the exact connection and equipment compatibility matter more to me than a broad resemblance to other accessories.",
    "Even a relevant adapter or useful cleaning supply would need to solve a current problem before I would choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical accessories but assume broader shopping needs than my occasional, specific purchases support."
}
